subject: BrightEcom pilot: 3.1x throughput, 28% cost drop — quick quote?
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@brightecom.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightEcom pilot: 3.1x throughput, 28% cost drop — quick quote?

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with the Redwood runtime. Quick recap from our side (attached full PDF):
- Peak throughput improved 3.1x on your nightly batch job (avg tokens/sec up from 450 to 1400)
- End-to-end latency for lookup flows reduced 42% (p95 380ms -> 220ms)
- Estimated inference unit cost dropped ~28% due to prefix caching + optimized batching
- No production incidents; KV-cache hit rate stabilized at ~58% after warmup

Would BrightEcom be open to a short customer-facing blurb we can share on our site? Two quick options we use:
1) A one-line endorsement we can quote in marketing (1–2 sentences)
2) A 10–15 minute recorded call for a short audio clip and a screenshotable quote

If you're comfortable, could you: (a) reply with a one-line sentence we can attribute to BrightEcom, or (b) tell me a 15-minute window that works this week and we’ll record the clip? We can also provide a sanitized one-liner draft to edit.

Attaching the pilot results PDF and the short throughput demo we recorded for the team.

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightEcom_pilot_results_v3.pdf (PDF, 280KB); throughput-demo-clip.mp4 (MP4, 8MB)

From: Olivia Park <olivia@brightecom.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan@brightecom.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightEcom pilot: 3.1x throughput, 28% cost drop — quick quote?

Dylan —

Really appreciate the clear recap and the PDF. The numbers match what our infra team logged during the pilot window. A couple notes: the cost reduction shown is accurate for inference spend but doesn’t include engineering time savings (we estimate another ~12% savings from simplified ops). Happy to say that on a call.

A one-line is fine for now. Draft below — feel free to edit for length/voice:
"Using Redwood cut inference cost and improved throughput dramatically in our live workflows — the team saw 3x throughput and measurable ops savings in two weeks."

If you want audio, I can do 15 minutes next Thursday 10/22 10:00–10:15am PT.

Best,
Olivia
Senior Director, Platform Engineering
BrightEcom
